messages:
nina_cs: Quick capture from todays onboarding runs (Brightlane, Sable, Nova). Recurring customer ask: a finance/export story for route-level chargebacks + a couple follow-ons. Triage pls.
tom_onboard: saw same  finance wants a file they can drop into their chargeback system (CSV or SFTP drop). Quote from Brightlane CFO: 'we need line items per route & team tag, otherwise we can't map costs to our internal P&L.'
iris_product: paste bullets + rough severity and I'll create a product intake card. If it's a renewal blocker we P0.
nina_cs: bullets: 
- economics export (critical): server-side daily export (CSV + optional SFTP/secure drop) with fields: date, org_id, team_tag, route, environment, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd, invoice_ref. Must be auditable. (renewal-risk: Brightlane, rev in ~4w)
- webhook/ndjson option (high): alternative to SFTP  POST ndjson to customer webhook with signing. Some customers prefer push.
- embedding refresh controls (med): TTL + on-demand reindex or per-doc delta re-embed.
- onboarding templated emails (low): short mitigation templates we can send during renewal outreach.
kai_eng: clarifying Qs: for SFTP drop do they need retention/rotation? For ndjson, any schema examples?
tom_onboard: SFTP retention = 90 days preferred. For ndjson one-line sample they requested: `{date,org,route,team,model,tokens_in,tokens_out,cost_usd,invoice_id}`. They want signing/ID for reconciliation.
iri_product: prioritization suggestion: P0 = economics export (for renewals <6w), P1 = webhook ndjson, P2 = embed controls, P3 = templates. We'll validate in triage using impact x confidence.
kai_eng: implementation idea: daily aggregator job -> compute authoritative rows and either (a) store accessible CSV in a per-org secure bucket with signed short-lived URL, (b) optionally push to registered SFTP or webhook. Minimal prototype: generate CSV + sample ndjson by EOD.
ops_bot: Reminder: CS/Product sync in 36 hours at 10:00 PT  Thread added to agenda under "renewal signals".
nina_cs: please mark Brightlane high-risk in renewal tracker and attach two verbatim quotes to the GH issue. Adding this to the agenda. Thanks all. :pray:
